answer.reason: In the EIA New Hampshire Electricity Profile 2024, Table 1 reports net generation by sector; the value for Electric utilities is 16,935,591 megawatthours. The smaller value, 6,888 megawatthours, corresponds to Self-generation, not Electric utilities.

A. 16,935,591 megawatthours
B. 6,888 megawatthours

Source citation: New Hampshire Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/newhampshire/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: A
